sources.notes: Some templates expect service exceptions; each-CRS, each-format, each-layer, and each-style can invoke a template more than once from the advertised Capabilities document.
The extra-GetMap parameter check resolves from Capabilities; the escaped-space GetMap check is skipped unless an advertised layer name contains a space.

localCapabilitiesResolution.boundary: Applicability and invocation cardinality are resolved against deterministic local production Capabilities. Exact deployed profile/version render identities remain unmaterialized.

alwaysRunDataIndependent.materializationInput: The exact deployed anonymous WMS Capabilities document after all eleven canonical publications and default profiles exist.
alwaysRunDataIndependent.materializationRule: Resolve every applicable successful image request, exclude requests whose asserted result is an exception or a source-defined skip, and deduplicate by the OpenGeo render identity before authenticated prewarming.

coverageBoundary.claim: The ten-request inventory is complete only for fixed dataset-specific basic.xml image identities. It is not a complete inventory of successful images requested by the always-run data-independent branch.

nextGate: Use the optional credential-free successful-image trace from a pinned diagnostic bridge run to materialize and checksum the capabilities-resolved identities, reconcile them against the exact deployed Capabilities document, prewarm both inventories through shared auth during an explicitly enabled processing window, verify anonymous exact-cache delivery, and only then run the pinned official ETS.
